details:
In some Udon code I'm working on that involves reparenting objects, I'm getting an "InvalidOperationException: Collection was modified" from an obfuscated call stack. This _seems_ to be happening in a different frame than the actual reparenting, but it's a bit hard to tell. Due to the obfuscation, I can't tell exactly what is causing this. Here's the callstack:

Repro world: https://vrchat.com/home/world/wrld_28ed70ce-cba3-43ca-ba5f-4f3e9722a279
Repro steps:
1. Join with two clients with humanoid avatars
2. With one client (tested in desktop mode), pick up the crown, releasing the mouse button immediately. Point it at the other avatar until a bone indicator appears, then click. This will trigger the exception.
